request: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.

parameters.mirror_plane: the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part

actions.relational_constraint: The part must be mirrored across the plane located on the not rounded end of the part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the not rounded end of the existing part and resolve the plane lying on that end.
steps: Identify the non-rounded end as the square terminal of the base rail in SEC-01. The corresponding planar reference is face code 0001, Brep_id FACE 7, located at x=80 mm.

Confirm from the front, back, top, and isometric views that this terminal is the straight rectangular end opposite the large rounded terminal; do not use the rounded terminal wall 0003 or either broad rail face as the mirror reference.
Create or select a datum plane coincident with square terminal face 0001. Orient the plane normal parallel to the rail longitudinal x direction, giving the mirror plane x=80 mm.

Select the complete existing solid body rather than an individual face or feature. The mirrored geometry must include SEC-01 Base rail, SEC-02 Blended socket support, and SEC-03 Blind cylindrical socket.
Apply a body-level mirror or geometry-pattern operation about the plane coincident with face 0001. Keep the original body and create the mirrored result as a second solid temporarily.

Ensure that the mirrored base rail extends from the x=80 mm plane in the opposite longitudinal direction. The original socket center near x=0 mm therefore produces a mirrored socket center near x=160 mm.

Preserve all detailed socket geometry in the mirrored result, including the outer boss cylinder 0008, annular opening 0009, inner bore cylinder 0010, and blind bore floor 0011. The bore axis remains parallel to the y direction after reflection.

Preserve the mirrored copy of the bulbous support 0007 and its continuous connection between the mirrored rail and socket boss; do not replace the support with a simplified extrusion or remove its stress-distributing blend.

Verify that the mirrored copy contacts the original over the full rectangular area of square terminal face 0001 and that there is no offset, angular mismatch, overlap error, or gap at the x=80 mm mirror plane.
Do not add sketches, extrusions, chamfers, fillets, or cuts because the requested modification is a full-body mirror and all original geometry is to be reproduced exactly.

actions.operation: Merge the mirrored part with the existing part
actions.target: the mirrored part created by the preceding action and the existing part
actions.relational_constraint: The mirrored and existing parts must be joined together as one body.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolve 'the existing one' to the original part body and use the mirrored part produced by the preceding action.
steps: Use the original complete solid as the Boolean base body and the complete mirrored solid from the preceding operation as the tool body.

Localize the joining interface at SEC-01 square terminal face 0001, Brep_id FACE 7. Its generated mirrored counterpart is coincident with the same x=80 mm plane and shares the full rail cross-section.
Confirm that the two bodies have valid volumetric contact across the complete terminal rectangle spanning the rail width from y=11 mm to y=23 mm and thickness from z=2 mm to z=6 mm.
Perform a Boolean union, fuse, or additive combine operation with the keep-tools option disabled so that only one resulting solid body remains.

Enable geometric refinement or remove redundant splitter geometry if supported. The coincident square terminal faces should become an internal, non-boundary interface rather than remain as duplicate external faces.

Do not merge or fill the blind cylindrical bores. Both the original and mirrored SEC-03 sockets must retain their radius 5 mm internal cylinders and planar blind floors as separate functional cavities within the unified solid.
Verify that SEC-02 and its mirrored copy remain attached to their respective rail regions and bosses after the union, with no detached shells, non-manifold edges, or failed blend surfaces.

Check the final longitudinal form: the original rounded terminal remains near x=-25 mm, the former square terminal plane at x=80 mm becomes the central joining plane, and the mirrored rounded terminal lies near x=185 mm.

Validate that the result contains exactly one solid and that all original and mirrored functional geometry is present: one continuous rail, two blended socket supports, and two blind cylindrical sockets.
Recompute the model and inspect front, back, top, bottom, side, and isometric views to confirm mirror symmetry about x=80 mm and a clean, gap-free Boolean union.

intention: Produce a single unified body from the existing part and its mirrored counterpart.
